about: Changes waiting for the operator's yes, run once from the phone: /approve lists them, /approve <id> shows one and a code, /approve <id> yes <code> runs it (powershell -File <script>, no arguments, detached through WMI). research/phone/actions/approvals.py says what may be listed. sha256 is of the script's text (CRLF -> LF, no BOM): an edited script is not run until this entry is updated.

items.title: Pin: drop the jump hedge AND 1.33x bet (trial) -- see pinsize, which keeps the hedge
items.description: Two edits to the pin bot's launcher (C:\kals-live-0925n\restart_bot.ps1). 1) The jump hedge (--hedge-jump 6) is switched off: the 10-30 read found 7 of its 8 hedges insured bets that won anyway and it caught none of the 3 real losses (about +$2-4 a day without it). 2) The bet goes from --bank-brake 4.00 to 3.00, about 1.33 times today's size (about +$2 a day on the 22 recorded days; the operator asked for caution, so not 1.5x). The script keeps a backup, checks the edited file still parses (else restores it and stops), then restarts pin through restart_bot.ps1, which waits until pin holds no open bet.
items.stop_rule: Back to --bank-brake 4.00 if any pin day during the trial is worse than -$100, or if the 11-10 read shows the extra contracts earning under 0c each (over +0.5c each -> consider 2.00).

items.title: FX taker: restart it on the 30-second window again
items.description: The FX code on the server is already back on the 30-second window (commit 42935f8), but the running FX taker still uses 45 seconds until it restarts. Today's 1:45 PM silver and platinum losses were both bought 44.9 seconds out, in the stretch added this morning: that stretch bought 96 and lost 2 (-$10.75), while 15-30 seconds bought 34 and lost 0 (+$3.32). The script waits for minutes 1-11 of a quarter hour, writes FX's stop file so it stands down with nothing open, waits for it to exit, removes the stop file and runs the server's keep-alive (KalsBoot), which starts FX again on the new code within a minute. FX misses at most one 15-minute round.
items.stop_rule: If FX loses again on the 30-second window before 11-03, the 11-03 read decides between keeping it, dropping platinum/silver, or pausing FX.

items.title: FX taker: one bank -- size every bet from both pots together
items.description: Restarts the FX taker on the one-bank code (it also carries the 30-second window, so it replaces fx30). From then on its bet size comes from ALL of FX's money together -- the currency pot (subaccount 4) plus the commodity pot (subaccount 5) plus its open bets -- at $20 of that bank per contract: today's ~$207 is 10 contracts, exactly what it bets now, so nothing changes today. It re-works the size only when it holds no bets: up at most +20% a step, down at once (after two cash reads agree). Its money caps move with the size (at 10 contracts: $70 in play per pool, -$25 day stop, -$10 stop line). NO MONEY MOVE IS NEEDED -- just approve. Why there are still two pots: Kalshi keeps cash per pool, the currency markets are paid from pool 0 and the commodities from pool 2, and a Kalshi subaccount lives in one pool (10-25: funding subaccount 5 in pool 0 was refused), so the phone cannot put the currency money into subaccount 5 today (/move 72 main sub5pool0 answers 'Kalshi does not list subaccount 5, weather pool'). If a pool-0 subaccount 5 is made later, the order is: 1) /move <sub 4's cash> sub4 main, then /move yes <code>; 2) /move <same amount> main sub5pool0, then /move yes <code>; FX then trades both pools from subaccount 5 by itself at its next restart. The script refuses unless the server has pulled this code and its self-test passes, waits for minutes 1-11 of a quarter hour, writes FX's stop file so it stands down with nothing open, waits for it to exit, removes the stop file and runs the keep-alive (KalsBoot), which starts FX again within a minute; FX misses at most one 15-minute round.
items.stop_rule: Back to the fixed 10 contracts (git revert of the one-bank commit, then a restart) if a resize ever lowers the size while the bank grew, or if FX loses more than $25 in a day at a size above 10 before 11-06.

items.title: Pin: 1.33x bet trial, KEEP the jump hedge (recommended over pin15)
items.description: One edit to the pin bot's launcher: the bet goes from --bank-brake 4.00 to 3.00, about 1.33 times today's size (about +$2 a day on the recorded days). The jump hedge stays ON: on pin's history (09-12 to 10-20) it would have cut the big fast losses (NEAR 10-03 -$87, ZEC 10-07 -$83, ZEC 10-18 -$33 to about -$1.50), worth +$76 to +$189 over those weeks, while its one live week (10-24 to 10-30) happened to have no fast loss and cost about $12.50. With a bigger bet, keeping insurance against the big fast losses is the cautious choice. The script keeps a backup, checks the edited file still parses (else restores it and stops), then restarts pin through restart_bot.ps1, which waits until pin holds no open bet. Choose this OR pin15, not both.
items.stop_rule: Back to --bank-brake 4.00 if any pin day during the trial is worse than -$100, or if the 11-10 read shows the extra contracts earning under 0c each.
